item.title: Outsmart Zigbee Smart Plug Universal | Requires Zigbee Hub | Energy Monitoring | Remote Control | Timer | Voice Control
item.description:
Important Note : A Zigbee Hub is required for this plug to work. This product will not function without a Zigbee Hub. Please contact us if you would like to learn more about what a Zigbee Hub is or how it works.

Outsmart Zigbee Smart Universal Plug - Energy Monitoring
Turn your regular electrical appliances into smart devices with the Outsmart Zigbee Smart Universal Plug. This Zigbee Smart Plug is designed for smart home automation, allowing you to remotely control connected appliances, monitor electricity consumption, set schedules, and create automated routines through the SmartLife app.

Unlike a WiFi Smart Plug that connects directly to your WiFi network, this Zigbee Smart Plug requires a compatible Zigbee Hub to operate. The plug communicates with the Zigbee Hub, which connects it to the SmartLife app for remote control and automation. This makes it a suitable choice for users who are building or expanding a Zigbee smart home system with multiple smart devices, including smart lights, smart switches, motion sensors, smart plugs, and other compatible Zigbee devices.

With built-in energy monitoring, you can check your appliance's electricity consumption and better understand how much power your devices are using. Monitor energy usage through the SmartLife app, identify appliances with higher power consumption, and use the information to manage your daily usage more efficiently. You can also combine energy monitoring with schedules, timers, smart scenes, and automation to create a more convenient and energy-conscious smart home.

Features:
• Requires Outsmart Zigbee Hub
• Remote control from anywhere
• Voice control via Google Home, Amazon Alexa, and Siri Shortcuts
• Supports automation and smart scenes
• Timer and scheduling function

⚠️ BEFORE ORDERING
Please make sure you understand the connection requirement before purchasing.
This is the ZIGBEE VERSION.
- Zigbee Hub REQUIRED
- Cannot connect directly to WiFi. User will need a zigbee hub (sold separately)
- Will not function without a compatible Zigbee Hub

Zigbee advantages :
- Suitable for a smart home with multiple Zigbee devices
- Ideal for expanding your Zigbee smart home ecosystem
- Supports multiple Zigbee devices such as smart plugs, smart lights, smart switches, and sensors
- Helps reduce the number of smart devices directly connected to your WiFi network
- Centralized connection through a compatible Zigbee Hub

If you only have a few smart devices and do not want to use a hub, consider our WiFi Smart Plug instead.

How to Connect:
• Download the SmartLife app and log in/register.
• Make sure a compatible Zigbee Hub is already connected to the SmartLife app.
• Tap “Add Device” and select the Zigbee Smart Plug.
• Reset the smart plug by pressing and holding the ON/OFF button for 10 seconds until the indicator light blinks rapidly.
• Follow the instructions in the app to complete pairing.
• ALL SET!
⚠️ Zigbee Version requires a compatible Zigbee Hub. The smart plug cannot connect directly to WiFi.
